success.description: A You unleash a horrific assault fuelled by a surge of energy granted by the Ruinous Powers. The attack inflicts +1 damage.

chaosStar.description: Your flesh twists and erupts with a new gift from your dark god - a mutation. Gain a random mutation. If it has the trait, deal additional damage equal to its value.

sigmarsComet.description: If the target is suffering from any corruption, +1 damage per corruption. +2 damage.

conservative.requirements: Engaged with target. The target or one of his allies must have rolled a # on a die in your presence previously during this encounter. Special: This attack targets one enemy in the current engagement. If the attack hits, another enemy in the engagement may suffer the effects, as well.

success.description: A The servant of Chaos unleashes a horrific assault fuelled by a surge of eldritch power granted by the Ruinous Powers. The attack inflicts normal damage.

chaosStar.description: The attacker is obliterated by the Ruinous Powers. It is immediately killed after the action is resolved. All targets in the engagement (friend and foe) suffer 1 wound, which cannot be avoided, redirected, or reduced by any means.

reckless.requirements: Used by a Chaos Spawn, Chaos Lord, or Engaged with target, a Chaos enemy must have rolled 3Dc during a previous Melee Attack this encounter. Special: This attack targets one enemy in the current engagement. If the attack hits, two other enemies in the engagement suffer the effects, as well.
